item.title: MDPPA posts 3.6% motorcycle sales growth in first half
item.description: Philippine motorcycle sales reached 939,528 units in the first half of 2026, up 3.58 percent from 907,054 units during the same period last year, according to the Motorcycle Development Program Participants Association (MDPPA).
